title: Homicide Squad New Orleans
description:
S01 E10 — The Rookie
Aided by the know-how of veteran officers in the department and his own investigative skills, Rookie Detective Donnie Willyard tracks down a suspect who allegedly shot a man in the front entrance of his home nearly 10 times.

title: The First 48 Presents: Homicide Squad Atlanta
description:
S01 E02 — The Dark Staircase
The Fallen Angel investigation takes homicide detectives back to the scene of the crime; as they sweep the city park for evidence, they discover a surveillance camera with vital footage of the victim's car at the time of her murder.

title: Homicide Squad New Orleans
description:
S02 E01 — Digital Grudge
An online dispute turns into a physical fight that ends with a mother losing her life; as Det. Fyfe unravels names of possible suspects, he zeroes in on a gang that has been terrorizing the city.

title: Homicide Squad New Orleans
description:
S02 E05 — Search on the Bayou
Detective Matt Riffle investigates the murder of a New Orleans native, who was shot and killed after a brief altercation; Det. Tanisha Smith investigates the homicide of a young mother and the abduction of her daughter.

title: Homicide Squad New Orleans
description:
S02 E04 — Bourbon Street Drive By
Detective Nick Davis investigates a homicide in the French Quarter after an innocent bystander is shot and killed; with minimal evidence at the crime scene, Det. Davis tracks a car seen fleeing Bourbon Street moments after the shooting.

title: Homicide Squad New Orleans
description:
S02 E02 — Beware Thy Neighbor
Detective Maurice Stewart investigates the murder of a woman, who was allegedly gunned down by her neighbor after an argument over cats and dogs.

title: Homicide Squad New Orleans
description:
S02 E07 — Fight and Flight
A night out turns into a tragedy, as Detective Matt Riffle works to uncover the circumstances that led to a father of six being fatally shot outside a nightclub.

title: Court Cam
description:
200th Episode Special Part 1
A special counting down some of the wildest and most outrageous courtroom moments to ever appear in the first 200 episodes of Court Cam.

title: Court Cam
description:
S02 E10 — Episode 10
A defendant takes a desperate stab at a prosecutor with a metal shank; a foul-mouthed woman goes off on her attorney; a state trooper delivers a powerful testimony.

title: Court Cam
description:
S02 E05 — Episode 5
A courthouse escape goes wrong; a woman collapses after getting convicted of conspiring to kill her husband; an out-of-control defendant bites a court officer.

title: Court Cam
description:
S03 E12 — Episode 12
A teen sues her parents; chilling testimony from the mastermind of a murderous prison escape; a hilarious judge handles the argument of a sovereign citizen perfectly.

title: Court Cam
description:
S04 E19 — Episode 19
A man accused of murdering his own family decides to defend himself and cross-examine his own son; things get tense between a judge and a public defender; a surprising act of forgiveness.

title: Court Cam
description:
S04 E25 — Episode 25
The mother of a murder victim comes face to face with the killer: her own grandson; a widow seeks her own form of justice; courthouse nuptials take a shocking turn.

title: Court Cam
description:
S05 E01 — Episode 1
A former stripper and porn actor shoots up a Trump hotel in Florida; an Alabama courtroom erupts after a verdict.

title: Court Cam
description:
S07 E13 — Episode 13
After a failed plea for leniency, an angry mother flips the bird to the media after her son is sentenced; a grieving woman begs the judge to keep her brother in prison; a judge must use his mute button to silence a foul-mouthed mom.

title: Court Cam
description:
S07 E16 — Episode 16
A maskless defendant tells the judge he's tested positive for tuberculosis; a grieving son forgives the woman responsible for his parents' deaths; a convicted murderer removed from the courtroom for smiling during a victim impact statement.

title: Court Cam
description:
S07 E33 — Episode 33
A murder victim's sister tears into the killer in court; a man facing drug charges shows up for his virtual arraignment without his pants; a grieving mother defends the woman responsible for her son's accidental death - her own sister; and more.

title: Court Cam
description:
S07 E36 — Episode 36
A woman accused of driving with a suspended license yells expletives at the judge; a grieving mother screams at her daughter's killer; a judge gets tough while sentencing a young father for aggravated robbery; and more.

title: Alaska PD
description:
S01 E05 — Love and Hate in Alaska
Sgt. Norman Hughes and Officer Robert Odom grapple with the distrust of the police as they try to keep Kotzebue safe; Sgt. Nathan Werner and Officer Gerrit Butler bring a personal touch in dealing with alcohol and drug-fueled crimes.

title: Alaska PD
description:
S01 E01 — Call of the Wild
Jaime Ramos from Virginia becomes Kodiak PD's only female police officer, and soon has her first encounter with the infamous Kodiak bear; Fairbanks officer Gerrit Butler, a former MMA professional, encounters a suspect who also knows martial arts.

title: Alaska PD
description:
S01 E03 — Taste of Blood
In Fairbanks, a wanted fugitive flees into the woods and the police's only lead is frozen footprints in the snow; when a killer bear becomes loose in Kodiak, officers must hunt it down before it strikes again.

title: Alaska PD
description:
S01 E04 — Arctic Survival
Officer Chris Cook questions his future in remote Kotzebue; officer Stephanie Jones has to battle her own soft-hearted nature to succeed as a rookie; officer Christopher Zenyuch is eager to prove himself in Fairbanks.
